theorems.name: Submission.sobolev_level_layer_cake
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (h : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), 2 ≤ n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → (∀ x, 0 ≤ h x) → 0 < ε → ∫⁻ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal ((t + ε) ^ ((n : ℝ) - 1)⁻¹ * μ.real {x | t + ε < h x}) = ENNReal.ofReal (((n : ℝ) - 1) / n * ∫ x in {x | ε < h x}, (h x ^ ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) - 1)) - ε ^ ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) - 1))) ∂μ)
